test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) to protect endangered species

(B) wildlife sanctuaries

(C) have been established

(D) across the country
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **BCAD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "**Wildlife sanctuaries**," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**
 
• Following the subject, "**have been established**" **(BC)** continues the logical sequence, explaining the action related to wildlife sanctuaries.
 
• **The next part,** "**to protect endangered species**" (A), explains the purpose of establishing the sanctuaries.
 
• **Ending with **"**across the country**" (D) completes the sentence by specifying the scope of the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BCAD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (BADC):** This option starts with "**Wildlife sanctuaries to protect endangered species have been established across the country**," which creates a grammatically incorrect and illogical sentence structure.
 
• **Option 2 (****BACD****):** This option starts with "**Wildlife sanctuaries to protect endangered species **have been established **across the country**," but the parts are not in the most logical order.
 
• **Option 4 (CBAD):** This option begins with "**have been established wildlife sanctuaries across the country to protect endangered species**," which does not provide a coherent sentence.
